steps.en: Prepare Node 20+, clone and start the app
steps.zh: 准备 Node 20+，克隆并启动应用

steps.en: Set a starting level and daily new-word target
steps.zh: 设置起点难度和每日新词数

steps.en: Present due reviews, then illustrated new words and recall questions
steps.zh: 先复习到期词，再展示新词插画和回忆题

steps.en: Answer by meaning, listening or spelling
steps.zh: 通过选义、听音或拼写作答

steps.en: Use the first answer to schedule reviews and save progress locally
steps.zh: 用首次作答安排复习，将进度保存在本机

value.en: Study an assembled illustrated corpus without building decks or running a model
value.zh: 直接学习现成插画词库，无需自建牌组或运行模型
